selected_expression_policy: Facts, necessary conventional lexical formulas and specific short phrases reviewed individually under 17 USC 102(b), 37 CFR 202.1(a) and Compendium 313.4(C); long original exposition is not licensed by an import marker or French expiry.
retained_originals_status: Original author proposals and complete raw articles remain audit evidence, with no selected-source grant for excluded original expression.

independent_authority_reading.reading: Ideas, procedures, concepts and discoveries are outside copyright; original expression remains distinct from factual content.
Words and short phrases are excluded; no automatic sentence-length threshold or blanket dictionary exemption is inferred.

independent_authority_reading.authority: US Copyright Office Compendium 313.4(C), PDF pages 28–29
independent_authority_reading.reading: Individual words and brief combinations contain de minimis authorship. Applied only to each actual chosen conventional phrase, pronunciation and necessary grammatical facts.
